meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Processes and analyzes data with resident-kernel engines (DuckDB, Polars) and one-shot tools. Use for CSV/parquet/JSON analysis, group-by/join/aggregation, time series, distributions, cleaning, or plotting a dataset.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析本地数据文件,快速获得统计汇总与图表。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要处理表格或 CSV 等数据文件,想快速做统计和示意图。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze local data files and quickly produce statistical summaries and charts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with spreadsheets or CSV data and want quick summaries and charts.

howto.what: Claude 会用 DuckDB、Polars 等常驻内核引擎直接分析 CSV、Parquet、JSON,做分组、聚合、时间序列、分布、清洗与绘图;它先探测文件大小与可用内存,再决定计算放哪、用哪个引擎。
howto.when: 当你要求分析、清洗或绘图某个数据集,或对数据做分组、聚合等计算时接管。

say.text: 帮我分析 data.csv,按城市分组算平均订单金额
say.note: 它会先探测文件再选引擎。

say.text: 把 sales.parquet 里 2024 年的记录清洗后画成趋势图
say.note: 绘图前会先读可视化规范。

say.text: 这个文件比内存大,用流式方式统计各分类数量
say.note: 超出内存的数据不会整体载入。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes CSV, Parquet and JSON with resident-kernel engines (DuckDB, Polars): group-by, joins, aggregation, time series, distributions, cleaning and charts. It probes file size and free RAM before placing the work.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to analyze, clean or plot a dataset such as CSV, Parquet or JSON, or to run group-by, aggregation and time series computation on it.

say_en.text: Analyze data.csv: average order amount grouped by city
say_en.note: It probes the file first, then picks the engine.

say_en.text: Clean the 2024 rows in sales.parquet and plot the trend
The file is bigger than RAM — stream a count per category
say_en.note: It won't fully load an out-of-RAM dataset.
